title: eichleria albescens
intro: Eichleria albescens, commonly known as the "Saraca asoca", is a flowering plant native to the tropical forests of India and Southeast Asia. It is considered a medicinal plant due to its various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood sugar levels, and act as an anti-inflammatory. The therapeutic actions of Eichleria albescens include its use as an antiseptic, analgesic, and antispasmodic, making it effective in treating various health conditions such as wounds, fever, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Eichleria albescens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
